Murder suspect searched ChatGPT for 'how to look sad'

In the Ketan Aggarwal murder case, police revealed in their chargesheet that suspect Sia Goyal searched on ChatGPT for "how to look sad" and information on how to behave after arrest. The chargesheet details these online searches conducted by Goyal.
